items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Edward Cleve, he came home several times. ... He was a jazz trumpet player.

ctx.x: Eddie Atkins played with the Olympia when he came back home. Eddie Walk Cliff, he came home several times. Where was he from? Where was he from? He was from St. James but he had been down there. Mm-hmm . What are some of the other bands that you heard when you were quite young, like out in the country, who did you hear that come out there from the city?
Well I heard the Olympia. Eddie Atkins was playing with the Olympia when he came back home. Edward Cleve, he came home several times.
